title: Authority deny record (contract 04)
description: One denial, as the enforcer records it (C-04.27). Every record is a log line in the hub's audit store (the connector ships its own over contract 05); a record with sink 'activity' is also an Activity entry on the reached chat, and then carries a contract 11 summary. Extends the line web-chat's remote access log writes today ({ts, email, instance, method, path, status}, web-chat-dev.worktrees/ae-int/lib/portal/access-log.js), which records writes and upgrades only and names an email, not a principal. Identical denials are coalesced: count says how many, first_ts and ts bound them.

ts.description: The last denial the record covers.

first_ts.description: The first denial the record covers; equal to ts when count is 1.

count.description: Identical denials coalesced into this record: same principal, chat, rule, reason, within 60 s for a log line and 10 minutes for an Activity entry.

enforcer.description: Who refused. hub: the hub's front (no Read, or its pre-check). connector: the route table or the inbound message filter. daemon: the daemon refused what the connector let through, which the connector sees as the daemon's 403: reason 'second-lock' when the body carries mirror (requireMirror, the queue) or is the answer engine's refusal (a 403 to an answer-origin request whose body is {ok: false, remote: true, error}, lib/server/isolated-origin.js), reason 'daemon-rule' for any other daemon 403, a surface-origin one with remote: true and no mirror included (C-04.21).

sink.description: log: an audit line only. activity: also an Activity entry on the reached chat (C-04.27 says when).

principal.description: Who was refused: the contract 03 principal record (schemas/03-principal.json), as the decision carries it.

chat_id.description: The chat the request was for, by its label (contract 03 section 2).

machine_id.description: The chat's machine, or null when the hub refused before choosing one.

decision_id.description: The decision the request was judged with, or null when none was current.

origin.description: session or answer: an HTTP request or upgrade on that origin. ws-inbound: a viewer-to-daemon socket message the filter dropped (C-04.18).

method.description: The HTTP method; WS for an upgrade (as access-log.js writes it); MSG for a dropped socket message.

path.description: The request path without its query string, cut at 512 (as access-log.js records it); for a dropped socket message, the message type.

rule.description: The row that decided, as remote-policy keyOf() prints it, or null for a default deny, a malformed path or a refusal before the table.

need.description: The table level the row needs, or null.

status.description: The HTTP status answered: 403, or 404 for no-access (the hub answers a chat the principal cannot read as it answers one that does not exist); null for a dropped socket message.

summary.description: Present when sink is 'activity': the entry's one line, built from a hub template (contract 11).

reason.description: no-access: the principal holds no Read (the hub's 404). level: the row's level is not held. requires: a specific the row needs is false. host-only and retired: the row's level. unknown: no row matched (default deny). malformed: remote-policy normalize refused the path. query: the row's refuse_query matched. ceiling: above the machine's ceiling. archived: a level the archived chat no longer allows. expired and no-decision: no current decision. second-lock: the daemon's level check refused what the connector allowed (a 403 whose body carries mirror, from lib/server/audience.js requireMirror or lib/server/routes/queue.js, or the answer engine's refusal, a 403 to an answer-origin request whose body is {ok: false, remote: true, error}, lib/server/isolated-origin.js): a table skew to fix, logged, an Activity entry, and a notice to the hub's admins. daemon-rule: any other daemon 403, a surface-origin one with remote: true and no mirror included: a body-level rule under X-WC-Remote (C-04.17, such as an html spawn): a log line only (C-04.21, C-04.27).
